item.title: Noah Kahan Brings Out Chappell Roan for Surprise ‘California’ Performance at Rose Bowl Show
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update! We've got some exciting news to share with you. Singer-songwriter Noah Kahan just made history with his biggest headlining show to date at the iconic Rose Bowl Stadium in Pasadena, California.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "On Saturday, August 15th, over 56,000 fans gathered to see Kahan perform a 27-song set as part of his The Great Divide World Tour. And, in a surprise move, he invited Chappell Roan to join him on stage for a special duet. The two sang 'California', a song from Roan's debut album, which tells the story of her journey from Missouri to Los Angeles to pursue a music career.
[Clip of Noah Kahan speaking: "I remember playing at Troubadour and being happy if that was the rest of my career..."]
Host: "Kahan expressed his gratitude to the crowd, reflecting on his journey from playing small venues to selling out the Rose Bowl. And, in a fun twist, he received a 'call from God' via a payphone on stage, teasing Roan's appearance.
[Clip of Chappell Roan speaking: "Noah always stands up for me, seriously..."]
Host: "Roan praised Kahan, saying he's a good person who's always supported her. The two performed a beautiful acoustic rendition of 'California', which marked a special moment in the show. Kahan's set also featured songs from his breakthrough album Stick Season and his latest album, The Great Divide, which spent three weeks at number one on the Billboard 200.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for this week's music update. Noah Kahan's The Great Divide World Tour is still going strong, with upcoming shows in North America and internationally. We'll be keeping an eye on this talented artist and his exciting collaborations. Thanks for tuning in!"
